subject: rc
title: RC.------VT.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-14, on the page where Braxton argues that race is 'directly related to the spread of people on the physical universe level, as well as the addition of given cosmic multi-ingredients (or vibrational alignments)' — and that the *concept* of race must be carefully distinguished from any one-dimensional or hierarchical reading. (C)RC — the *concept* of race, marked with the (c) prefix to insist it is conceptual not essential — is crossed with VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). The diagram poses that race-as-concept is structurally crossed with vibrational dynamics, but only as a downstream-of-multi-factors claim. RC outputs to VT-DY (the crossing), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), PHY-U-C (physical universe context), POL-DYM (political dynamics), and MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). VT-DY then chains: → POST (postulation) → AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → MT-INFO (music information). Structural argument: the concept of race fans into five outputs, of which only one (vibrational dynamics) leads further into postulation, affinity dynamics, and music information. The other four (time-continuum, physical-universe context, political dynamics, multiple diversification) terminate as separate sibling outputs. The diagram thus makes Braxton's anti-essentialist point structural: race-as-concept is generative across multiple unrelated domains, and *only* its vibrational-dynamics output reaches the music-information layer that interests him.
